_comment: Semgrep findings we accept on purpose, which nosemgrep cannot reach
(lockfiles are JSON, so they cannot carry a comment).  The Semgrep job's
SARIF filter (scripts/filter_semgrep_sarif.py) drops a finding ONLY when
its rule, its file, the package it names AND that package's locked
version all match an entry.  Anything else on these files still reaches
Code Scanning, and so does this finding once the locked version changes.
The filter logs every entry that matched nothing: delete those.
